snippet.title: HELLDIVERS™ 2 x WARHAMMER 40,000 Announcement | Warhammer Skulls 2026
snippet.description:
We’re excited to announce a collaboration between HELLDIVERS™ 2 and Warhammer 40,000, bringing the next Legendary Warbond to the Galactic War later this year.

More details coming soon.

See all the Skulls 2026 reveals on Warhammer Community: https://www.warhammer-community.com/en-gb/articles/2eknkrto/skulls-2026-the-warhammer-video-games-festival/
